name: RLBench
summary: 基于 CoppeliaSim 的大规模机器人操作学习套件，提供大量可程序化任务、示范轨迹和多视角视觉观测，可用于强化学习、模仿学习以及可控世界模型评测。
scale: 100+ manipulation tasks · demonstrations generated on demand
license: MIT code license; simulator and assets have separate terms
wmNote: 任务覆盖广且可重复生成，适合快速实验和消融；仿真视觉与物理仍存在 sim-to-real 差距。
summaryEn: A programmable robot manipulation suite built on CoppeliaSim, offering many tasks, demonstrations, and multi-view observations for reinforcement learning, imitation, and controllable simulation.
wmNoteEn: Broad, reproducible task generation makes experimentation efficient, while simulation appearance and physics create a sim-to-real gap.
scaleZh: 100+ 项操作任务 · 可按需生成示范
organizationsZh: 帝国理工学院及合作机构
licenseZh: 代码采用 MIT 许可；模拟器和资产另有条款

evidence.sourceTitle: [1909.12271] RLBench: The Robot Learning Benchmark & Learning Environment
evidence.statement: Manipulation tasks expose visual/proprioceptive observations and unlimited motion-planned demonstrations with a documented generator.
